body.assignment: Analyst stage for the frozen exploratory A-share close-momentum case. Baseline candidate is the five-observation raw return (lookback five, direction one, no normalization, no volatility window, no absolute-return bound). Using only the inline frozen sources on the board (source_contract, research_contract, data_quality, price_profile, initial_inspection, and the three per-symbol unadjusted close tables), produce qualitative findings on: (1) applicability constraints any executable close-momentum signal must respect on this sample — unadjusted CNY closes from a current non-vintage download, observed union of dates is not an exchange calendar so absences prove nothing, no filling, close-only jumps cannot identify corporate actions, all inputs at or before the signal close, execution no earlier than the next observed close, last-row signals have no execution observation; (2) source-supported motivations for at most ONE alternative specification relative to the baseline — weigh the observed cross-symbol one-observation return dispersion and volatility heterogeneity versus isolated large single-observation moves, and state which spec fields any motivation would touch (normalization and volatility window, absolute daily-return bound, lookback, direction) and what added parameter or eligibility exclusion each would require; (3) what evidence a later independent evaluation would need before any adoption, superiority or investment-benefit claim. Keep every finding qualitative with valid fact references; no numeric copies, no count equations, no alpha, tradability, superiority or calendar/corporate-action inference. Preserve the exploratory, unproven status of all hypotheses.

body.statement: Any executable close-momentum signal on this frozen sample must respect a strict point-in-time boundary: inputs to a signal dated at a given close may come only from observed rows at or before that close, because the download is current rather than a vintage archive; execution may be dated no earlier than the next observed close after the signal; and the signal formed on each symbol's terminal observed row therefore has no execution observation within the sample. The observed union of dates is not an exchange calendar, so a date absent from the union cannot be read as a market closure or suspension, and no filling of absent dates is permitted. Eligibility rests only on genuinely observed trailing rows, with warmup exclusions recorded separately from closes required per signal; see the warmup, eligibility and next-observed-close fact refs for exact counts.

body.statement: All prices in the bundle are unadjusted closes quoted in CNY per share at one symbol per observed date, obtained from a current download rather than a vintage archive, with retrieval occurring after the research window; the baseline expression is a ratio of such closes and hence carries no currency or volatility unit and no annualization. Because the series are unadjusted and close-only, an isolated jump between adjacent observed closes cannot be attributed to a split, dividend or other corporate action, and the bundle contains no volume, bid/ask or cost context for any move. These rows are exploratory development observations and never a holdout.

body.statement: At most a single alternative specification is motivated, and only as an unproven exploratory hypothesis. The one-observation return dispersion recorded in the price profile is heterogeneous across the three names, while the baseline applies no normalization, so raw trailing returns do not share a common scale across symbols; this is the stronger and more pervasive motivation and points at the normalization field together with a new volatility_window parameter, whose definition divides the trailing return by trailing daily-return SD times the square root of the lookback, adds a positive-volatility eligibility condition, and deepens warmup exclusions as the window lengthens — a scale transform that neither removes systematic risk nor constitutes an annual Sharpe ratio. The weaker, competing motivation is the isolated large single-observation moves concentrated in the more volatile names, which would instead touch max_absolute_daily_return and introduce a return-magnitude eligibility exclusion. Neither motivation touches lookback or direction, since the frozen profiles give no evidence for a different horizon or sign, and no descriptive comparison of such variants can prove a revision better.

body.statement: Before any adoption, superiority or investment-benefit claim, a separate future evaluation would need evidence that is absent from this frozen bundle: forward return labels generated after the development window with a point-in-time universe and membership, transaction costs and bid/ask availability to establish executable prices, adjusted or corporate-action-annotated prices so unadjusted jumps can be interpreted, an official exchange calendar to date observations, and genuinely untouched out-of-sample data, since retrieval occurred after the research window and the sample is a small fixed convenience sample. Within this episode, descriptive score statistics and any coverage or scale consequences of a revision cannot establish superiority, alpha, tradability or investment benefit; adoption or retention is a research decision with explicit assumptions, not a performance demonstration.
